alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 28 at 7:49AM EDT until September 28 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northeast winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves 1 to 3 feet. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT this afternoon. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
